source_arm: S1 trainable-table decisive checkpoint, with the complete graft restored to its seed-matched clean state

groups.early_mlp_layers_00_05: MLP parameters only in decoder layers 0 through 5

interventions: sufficiency: clean backbone receives the poisoned values for the registered early-MLP group
necessity: poisoned backbone has the registered early-MLP group restored to clean
endpoint_controls: complete poisoned backbone transplanted into clean checkpoint
complete poisoned backbone restored to clean

threshold_derivation.source: the downstream deletion/localization claim is defined at the S1 assay resolution
threshold_derivation.interpretation: the intersection must independently account for at least the 0.15 ASR effect that the security assay was designed to resolve

decisions.primary_necessity: lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Student-t interval over five seed-level poisoned-ASR drops exceeds 0.15, evaluated separately in each size
decisions.secondary_sufficiency: lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Student-t interval over five seed-level clean-adjusted ASR gains exceeds 0.15, evaluated separately in each size
decisions.endpoint_validity: both full-backbone directions have lower 95% endpoints above 0.15 and both no-op conditions exactly reproduce their source ASR
decisions.no_compound_gate: necessity and sufficiency are separate estimands; cross-size outcomes are reported without requiring a conjunction

selection_disclosure: The early-MLP intersection was selected prospectively for S4 because the separately tested all-MLP and layers-00-05 groups passed S3 necessity. S4 is a confirmatory follow-up to S3, not independent replication of an unselected hypothesis.
verification: full replay of every endpoint and registered intervention from sealed S1 checkpoints; source/output manifests; raw disagreement and decision reproduction

budget.scale_justification: the stage tests the single causal intersection licensed by S3 across all ten independent source checkpoints; 1024 prompts preserve the registered resolution and five training seeds per size estimate optimizer-run variability
